subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where Argus drives a feature draft, the system shall let Argus run rounds and request the lock and leave the lock approval to the human operator.
rationale: Argus can drive; only a human locks (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-4)
fit_criterion: An Argus-driven fixture draft reaches readiness and an approval request, and Argus's own approval attempt is refused.
